meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 它会先派子代理去读文档、示例和现有代码,再产出一份分阶段实施计划:每阶段写明要复制哪段文档内容、验证清单和不要踩的坑,最后加一轮验证阶段。
howto.when: 当你要求规划一个功能、任务或多步实现时触发,尤其在使用 do 执行之前。

say.text: 帮我为这个新功能做一份分阶段实施计划
say.note: 会先生成 Phase 0 文档调研

say.text: 先查清这个库的真实 API 再规划
say.note: 要求引用具体文档来源

say.text: 给每个阶段加上验证清单和反模式提醒
say.note: 计划中补上验证与防坑项

howto.what_en: It dispatches subagents to read docs, examples and existing code, then produces a phased implementation plan: each phase cites what to copy from docs, a verification checklist and anti-pattern guards, ending with a verification phase.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before executing it with do.

say_en.text: Make a phased implementation plan for this new feature
Check the library's real APIs from docs before planning
Add a verification checklist and anti-pattern guards to each phase
say_en.note: Each phase gets checks and guards
